hooks.command: J="$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json"; p=$(jq -r --arg c "$PWD" '(.plugins["baseline@airthings"]//[]) as $e | ((($e|map(select(.projectPath==$c)))+$e)[0].installPath) // empty' "$J" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$p" ] && [ -x "$p/scripts/guard.sh" ] && exec "$p/scripts/guard.sh"; exit 0

J="$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json"; jq -e --arg c "$PWD" '(.plugins["baseline@airthings"]//[]) | any(.projectPath==$c)' "$J" >/dev/null 2>&1 || claude plugin install baseline@airthings -s project -y >/dev/null 2>&1; true

J="$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json"; p=$(jq -r --arg c "$PWD" '(.plugins["baseline@airthings"]//[]) as $e | ((($e|map(select(.projectPath==$c)))+$e)[0].installPath) // empty' "$J" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$p" ] && [ -x "$p/scripts/context.sh" ] && exec "$p/scripts/context.sh"; exit 0
